assumptions: Only existing arcbuild.admin.construction holders can activate instant completion; no player or group permissions are added.

Before: admin button accelerated the ordinary paid per-block state machine. After: remaining blocks are placed without material debit, replacement items or operation-progress rewards. Already settled book and material debits are not refunded; pending receipts settle before switching.

Illustrative low/base/high operator throughput is 1/3/10 houses per day, bounded to 10000 plan changes per house and 4096 per batch. This is administrative creative issuance, not normal recurring player income.

vault and tokens mint/burn remain zero in the changed path. Item issuance is separate: before zero unpaid blocks, after up to 10000 unpaid blocks per operator-selected house. No currency conversion or market value is assumed.

Normal player building costs, one-time book consumption, max changes, protections and ore exclusions stay unchanged. Admin completion emits no construction progression event, so this action cannot directly farm operation-triggered contracts.

Admins could give resulting blocks to players and indirectly affect supply; this is explicit owner-authorized creative administration equivalent to manual creative placement. Ordinary users cannot activate it. No new drop, container contents or loot table is authored.
EconomyShopGUI SELL remains current/conditional and the planned SELL-to-contract transition is unchanged. No SHADOW flow is counted as active income.
Instant intent and cursor are durable before world changes; replay compares exact before/after states and never issues resource outputs. Unknown storage outcomes stop safely.
